notes.title: 1.15a Raid changes
notes.content:
As many people have requested I will be changing up how raids work a bit + other fixes

Patch notes:

Changes
[list]
[*] Fixed diagonal movement
[*] Lowered sprinkler sound effect to be less annoying
[*] Nerfed wolf armor to give less move speed
[*] Buffed some bosses, increasing hp and damage
[*] A bunch of item balancing
[*] Magic food consumption increased
[*] Whetstone repair nerfed slightly 
[*] Increased day duration by 10 minutes, making it 30minutes per day instead of 20. Giving more time to advance through crafting tiers and experiment
[*] Made the raids weaker at the beginning of the game and harder later
[*] Buffed health of late game enemies
[*] Fixed red screen flash effect in multiplayer
[*] Fixed sounds in multiplayer
[*] Buckets no longer need to be refilled after being filled the first time.
[*] Raid enemies will no longer appear in your base, but now they wont ignore your base either, if you are far from your base and enemy finds your base in the path to reach you, some of them will do damage passing through it.
[*] Made blood mood effect slightly lighter
[*] Enemies will now collide with themselves, making melee enemies harder to cheese since you cant stack them up anymore.
[/list]

notes.content:

[*] Fixed weird glitch with some items popping up on your cursor from inventories

[*] Added trash bin to inventory
[*] Slightly lowered pumpking boss spawn
[*] Balanced some day 20+ raids
[*] Fixed the game crashing on raids at days 37 and 42
[/list]

notes.title: "Slug" update v1.0 Official release!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
Sorry it took so long, but we are finally here, leaving early access, biggest update as of yet, hopefully you all will enjoy it!

PS: This is not the end, I will continue to try and fix any issues that you may find and as always, all the feedback is appreciated!


[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]

[h2]New added:[/h2]
[list]
[*]New playable character "Sahara" 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38410152/e39af9c2699e481116f8ed8105d8f8b000526af8.png[/img]
[*] "Easy" mode, since a lot of people requested easier gameplay, this will be an alternative to normal mode, still giving access to raids but making the gameplay a lot easier, giving automatic HP regen, same as sandbox mode, just a bit slower, reducing creature speed/dmg and other changes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38410152/2f30793f6e5a71bd04159e68d7ee25e3680b6d15.png[/img]
[*] Now each difficulty mode will give different starting items, sandbox giving the best ones and hardcore giving the worst.
[*] Added screen effect when getting hurt, to notice damage easier, especially when starving.
[*] Arrow turrets (require arrows as ammo)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38410152/a48db10e1e850fed7eadb963fa28ae95a417ecfa.png[/img]
[*] Iron fishing rod for faster casting and increased durability over the wooden one.
[*] Huge Slashers sword.
[*] Bunny/Knight/Elite warg badge accessories.
[*] Sword sheet accessory.
[*] Rare blue rose (flower).
[*] Hay bale decoration.
[*] 4 new statues.
[*] Gold crown (helmet).
[*] Gold sword.
[*] Viking helmet.
[*] Added rare swordfish.
[*] Added random rocks to ocean biome.
[*] Added coal rocks to the world.
[*] Added Dirt/Snow/Sand piles in the world.
[*] Mech bird vehicle
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38410152/de0a6fa24637d61c0479a6112f440ffe79edde4e.png[/img]
[*] "Cherry blossom", "Never stay down" and "Lonely harp" tunes.
[*] A bunch of new SFX, plus some updates to older ones.
[*] Added a simple tune to the main menu.
[*] Updated the wiki to include all of the creatures and additional improvements. [url=https://underlings.fandom.com/wiki/Underlings_Wiki]Wiki page[/url]
[*] 2 New console commands "/help" to list all commands and "/togglerain" to toggle rain/snow on and off.
[*] Added warning to saves that are not compatible with current version, can still be played but will be quite broken.
[*] Added a bunch of random speech bubbles that can happen from time to time, suggesting what you might want to do.
[/list]


[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased fishing rod casting speed and reduced the duration needed to catch fish and improved the chances of catching something.
[*] Increased the plants that can be planted in plant pots.
[*] Changed the way worlds are generated to make them smoother.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38410152/4171ebc7048ad13aef0ceb0f5958f1e44be3a8f3.png[/img]
[*] Updated the maps to better show exploration.
[*] Reduced the roll cooldown.
[*] Variuos balancing changes to items and creatures.
[*] Balancing changes to bosses and raids.
[*] Improved skills for bosses and some creatures.
[*] Changed the way raids appear on the map to make it smoother.
[*] Updated the attack for "Wood staff"
[*] Improved the way fertilizer works to instantly grow the plant instead of requiring multiple uses.
[*] Improved how gates look, making them a bit bigger.
[*] Increased the amount of arrows crafter per craft.
[*] Improved a lot of building placements.
[*] Fixed snowfall in tundra.
[*] Updated some inputs to look better and smoother.
[*] Improved raid notification for multiplayer.
[/list]


This is the biggest update so far, hopefully worth the 1.0 mark.
If people will be interested, I will keep updating the game! =]

notes.title: "Shadow" update v0.9a
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
Might not look like a big update, but this was necessary to improve the game and took quite a lot of time, hope you will like it =]


[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]

[h2]New added:[/h2]
[list]
[*]New playable character "Light" 
[*] Items to summon late game bosses (Skull of the undeath, tentackle of the tentareach and underlords throne)
[*] A rare "Watchers sword" drop
[*] Throne decoration
[*] Armor cases to display your badass armor sets
[*] Inventory full speech bubbles from your character ;P
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38410152/4cbe65b006074b471be362975706a0d7dca25166.png[/img]


[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reworked most of the chunk loading mechanics, which means you can now play larger worlds with weaker computers, hopefully less crashes and smoother gameplay
[*] Reduced loading times in half
[*] Minor balancing and description changes
[*] Ranged enemy attacks no longer destroy nature (trees,rocks,etc) and can only damage your structures
[/list]


Additionally updated the wiki quite a lot, adding list of commands to add items if you want to cheat a bit :P
https://underlings.fandom.com/wiki/Underlings_Wiki


As always more to come in the future as I prepare for the big 1.0 release in a couple of weeks ^_^

As always more to come in the future.

[h2]New added:[/h2]

[*] Whetstone for repairing 40 of item durability
[*] Infused whetstone for repairing 100 of item durability, made by processing normal wheststones in infuser
[*] Musket with steel balls as ammo for late game
[*] Added hardstone floor
[*] Added candles as lights
[*] Added arcane herbs
[*] Added keybind for shift click ( move item to other inventory) and ctrl click (split stack of items)

[/list]


[h2]Changes:[/h2]

[*] Improved charge attack of some creatures, where before they would spin in one spot after charging
[*] Slightly lowered the amount of villages spawning in grasslands
[*] Slightly increased the distance at which you can build
[*] Improved sounds of some old tunes
[*] Reduced the spawns of second boss (Tentareach) and changed so spectres summon sword skeletons instead of normal skeletons

[/list]


[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you could pick up armor from inventory when it is closed

[h2]Additionally we now have a discord:[/h2]
